# Internal templates

Templates used by maintainer and automation workflows. They are deliberately
kept out of `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` so they do not appear in the public issue
picker, where they would misrepresent how the site's content is produced.

To use one, copy its body into a new issue and apply the labels named in its
front matter.

| Template                                   | Purpose                                     |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| [bot-writing-task.md](bot-writing-task.md) | Scope a drafting task for an agent workflow |
